profileLabel: Center-left economics (medium confidence); transparency-oriented institutions (low confidence)
summary: Benguet representative with 389 principal-authored bills. Authored a P200 wage increase, 14th-month pay, a national minimum wage, farm-gate price regulation, stronger National Food Authority powers, a ban on generation-utility cross-ownership, a livelihood program for disadvantaged workers, right-to-information, a bank-secrecy waiver for officials, medical parole for elderly detainees, a false-information penalty and a ban on online gambling.
caveat: Civil-liberties and social scores net to zero from offsetting signals. Bill-based; no votes reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Authored a P200 wage increase, 14th-month pay and national minimum wage (-2), farm-gate price regulation and NFA powers (-2), a livelihood program for disadvantaged workers (-2), generation-utility cross-ownership ban (-1) and plastic-bag excise (-1). Five issues.
